signals.text: 8 open PM roles across 3 US offices

profile.description: Crusoe is building a cost-effective, scalable, and easy-to-use cloud platform, purpose-built for compute-intensive AI and HPC workloads.

bullets: Product roadmap expertise: A track record of owning progressively complex and cutting edge multi-year product roadmaps and multiple wins bringing novel products to market.
High-Performance Compute Experience: Direct experience with high-performance compute, data center, or similarly demanding compute infrastructure.
A Passion for Good Requirements: A genuine passion for writing excellent product requirements, and a clear understanding of the distinction between market, product, and…
GPU & Rack-Scale Literacy: Fluency in GPU roadmaps and rack-scale architecture.
Cross-Functional Leadership: A track record of tight, effective partnership with technical program/project managers and hardware engineering leads on first-of-a-kind builds.
Roadmap Ownership: Drive the vision for bare metal compute, encompassing GPU/CPU offerings, rapid provisioning systems, and full lifecycle management.
Process & Operational Design: Define the end-to-end customer experience when something goes wrong — the ticketing workflow, escalation paths, and process behind it — in close…
Outcome Management: Ensure tight alignment between hardware and software layers to deliver a differentiated bare metal experience.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead initiatives across engineering and infra-ops to deliver provisioning, enhanced observability, and customer self-service capabilities.
Customer & Market Synthesis: Partner with Sales and GTM teams to transform customer feedback into roadmap priorities, ensuring deep product-market fit.
